checklist.evidence: White SYSTEM above red FAILURE, large and legible in most frames.
RGB split and smeared block displacement on SYSTEM at 0.21s, 3.12s, 3.96s and 4.79s. Faint grain.
Dark background with grain, chromatic smear and flicker read as a failing signal. There are no obvious scanlines or tracking bars.

problems: Between glitch bursts the text is clean, so the TV-breakdown feel is weak. There are no visible scanlines, tracking bars or screen distortion.
The late glitch on SYSTEM smears so heavily that the word is nearly illegible at 3.96s and 4.79s.
FAILURE is offset to the right of SYSTEM, which looks like an accident instead of a deliberate stagger.
The ERR line is small and low-contrast, and it dims often, so it is hard to read.
FAILURE is almost never glitched, so the effect is uneven. The upper half is busy and the lower area is empty.
judge.verdict: Clear, legible SYSTEM FAILURE title with real RGB-split glitch bursts. It is fairly generic and the broken-TV treatment is light. A user would probably accept it as a first draft but might ask for more screen distortion.
